Update Trace or its data

Usage:
  trace update [command]

Available Commands:
  intel       Refresh the bundled intel database
  playbooks   Fetch the latest playbook library
  rollback    Roll back to the previous binary version
  self        Update the binary to the latest release

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for update

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace update [command] --help" for more information about a command.
